title: Automating Legacy MFC Apps With No UIA -- HTS Playbook
desc: MFC owner-drawn controls have almost no UIA patterns -> Win32 PostMessage fallback required. CMaskEditEx: WM_CHAR only (never EM_SETTEXT/EM_SETSEL -- double input). GetSupportedPatterns() on MFC = COM corruption -- use TryGetCurrentPattern() per pattern. OCR triple cross-validation for price/candle data. FuzzyDigitMatch: Levenshtein ≤2 for bitmap OCR instability.
steps: [v6.2+ DISCOVERY FAST-PATH] MFC/Afx windows (nkrunlite/Heroes4/HTS) have no meaningful UIA tree -- v6.2 SKIPS UIA batch traversal during discovery (a11y find/inspect/windows/ocr). Completes in 1-5s instead of 50s. Explicit targeting still uses UIA when ControlType exposes a pattern; only the discovery scan is bypassed. Side benefit: simple-pattern a11y find now auto-enumerates MDI child windows, so simple title wildcards resolve MDI panels without requiring {proc:'nkrunlite',title:...} JSON5. Score output (e.g. score={domain:1.00,proc:0.86,cls:0.54,title:0.22}) on [OK] line shows field discrimination -- any 1.00 field not in your grap is a precision candidate.

LegacyControlZoo: HTS pattern reproduction controls added (MaskEdit rejecting WM_SETTEXT and accepting WM_CHAR only, owner-drawn icon-only Buy/Sell buttons with empty Name, owner-drawn ListBox price grid, modal overlay blocker) provide a no-Heroes4-needed harness to validate WM_CHAR path, OCR fallback, and modal-detection logic in CI.
author: claude
